integrity: The theorem follows from explicit cut-monotonicity, constructive reachability, exact maxima, reversible neutral-flip graph and Boolean incidence operator spectral proof. Bounded exhaustive and floating spectral checks are supporting regression evidence, not universal certificates.
scientific_limitations: Applies to closed-neighborhood binary minority with tie retention and independent uniform vertex selection on complete split graphs only. No exact absorption time or globally unique stationary law in multiple-class cases; novelty qualified by inaccessible primary full texts and possible unindexed priority. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Parity-controlled attractors and a universal relaxation gap on complete split graphs
